title: Turosmart BOV Kompact Dual Port-25mm/34mm
description:
The Turbosmart Kompact Dual Port 25mm Blow-Off Valve is a high-performance, direct replacement for weak factory plastic bypass valves. Designed with a 50/50 split operation, it vents simultaneously to the atmosphere for the signature blow-off sound while recirculating back into the intake to prevent stalling, backfiring, and rich fuel conditions on airflow-metered (MAF) engines.



Engineered with billet aluminum construction and precision-machined brass pistons, the Kompact Dual Port handles high boost levels without flexing or leaking. Its compact body makes it an easy, space-saving fit in tight engine bays, offering improved throttle response, faster boost recovery between shifts, and long-term durability.



Key Features

• 50/50 Dual Port Operation: Combines atmospheric venting audio with intake recirculation for smooth driveability and zero MAF sensor issues.

• Billet Aluminum Construction: Built to withstand high boost pressures and harsh under-hood temperatures without cracking like OEM plastic valves.

• Precision Brass Piston: Provides fast response, airtight sealing, and long service life without relying on fragile rubber diaphragms.

• Easily Adjustable Cap: Allows quick spring preload tuning to match your specific vacuum setup and engine setup.



Product Specifications

• Brand: Turbosmart

• Operation Type: Dual Port (50/50 Recirculating & Atmospheric)

• Color / Finish: Anodized Black
